description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext
Mirran Spy and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger
Resolve the Mirran Spy trigger, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to put up to one card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library, and then causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
